name: terragrid
description: TerraGrid — Industrial Battery Site Configurator. Design, visualize, and save battery storage sites.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n FE,BE -c cyan,blue "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w frontend && npm run test -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
